headline: Wildlife clip hits 2,645.9x as animal and psychology niches get scored
paragraphs: Today's run filled in niches that had 0 to 9 channels yesterday: animal-facts 0 to 40, psychology 0 to 38, space-astronomy 9 to 40. Space-astronomy 35 to 84 and disasters 40 to 80 reflect larger samples, not a market shift. Top scores: real estate investing 94, personal finance 92, mythology 90.

Breakouts in newly scored niches: Wildlife Ethology's roadrunner video (2,645.9x, 5,988,916 views, 7,480 subscribers) and Primordia's T. rex video (925x, 2,913,595 views). Philosophy and Stoicism has the highest typical best outlier of the five niches noted today, 25.9x.

Five more Hindi-language channels were flagged and will be dropped, among them MURMURAVI11 (52,759x). Added three niches to track: ev-green-tech, travel-guides and hands-only-cooking, from 2026 roundups, not this week's data. Verdicts rely on titles; thumbnails did not load.
